prompt: Design a high-fidelity 1536×864 desktop application comp for pod-god, a solo podcast creator. This is a designed software surface, not a poster. Use a focus canvas with contextual tool drawer: a narrow left icon rail for Chat, Production, Player, Activity, and Settings; a slim top strip with project name “Charlie — Fable 5 Prompting”, stage progress from Idea through Audio, and a compact jobs status display; a dominant central chat canvas headed “Make a podcast with me” using the real prompt “I need a podcast about Charlie explaining how to prompt models” and an episode proposal for “1. Why Fable 5 Is a Different Beast”; one full-height right drawer titled “Script: Episode 1” with Draft, Prompt & Cues, and Transcript tabs, editable title and summary, ordered script sections, and collapsed Advanced controls; and a compact persistent transport along the bottom of the chat canvas. Mark generated example values “ILLUSTRATIVE CONTENT”. Use matte near-black and charcoal surfaces, fine gray seams, warm off-white text, amber only for current state and primary action, green only for success, red only for failure. Humanist sans for conversation, condensed mono for status. TP-7 is a material and control-quality reference: precise labels, compact displays, tactile transport controls, disciplined geometry. Hermes Agent is a polish and hierarchy reference: generous composition, authored moments, clear progressive sequence. No blue, gradients, glass, neon, rounded-card bento grid, fake analytics, invented metrics, or decorative imagery. Make chat unmistakably primary while preserving every capability through progressive disclosure.
name: Focus Canvas + Tool Drawer
